description: This file defines the 'FileItem' class for Drupal's file field type plugin, including schema, property definitions, storage settings, form handling, and sample data generation.

classes.name: FileItem
classes.description: Defines the file field type plugin class for Drupal, including schema, property definitions, storage settings, form handling, and sample data generation.

methods.name: defaultStorageSettings
methods.description: Returns default storage settings for the file entity, including target type and URI scheme.

methods.name: defaultFieldSettings
methods.description: Returns default field settings such as allowed file extensions, directory, max filesize, and description field.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Defines the database schema for the file field, including columns, indexes, and foreign keys.

methods.name: propertyDefinitions
methods.description: Defines data properties for the file field, including display flag and description.

methods.name: storageSettingsSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary of storage settings; overridden to return empty to avoid redundancy.

methods.name: storageSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing storage settings, including display options and upload destination.

methods.name: fieldSettingsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for editing field-specific settings like directory, extensions, size, and description.

methods.name: validateDirectory
methods.description: Validates and trims the file directory path input.

methods.name: validateExtensions
methods.description: Validates the list of allowed file extensions, ensuring proper format and security.

methods.name: validateMaxFilesize
methods.description: Validates the maximum file size input.

methods.name: getUploadLocation
methods.description: Returns the upload location URI with tokens replaced.

methods.name: doGetUploadLocation
methods.description: Static method to generate the upload location URI based on settings and tokens.

methods.name: getUploadValidators
methods.description: Returns validators for file uploads based on current settings.

methods.name: generateSampleValue
methods.description: Generates a sample file entity with random data for testing or default purposes.

methods.name: isDisplayed
methods.description: Determines if the file should be displayed when rendering content.

methods.name: getPreconfiguredOptions
methods.description: Returns preconfigured options for the field, empty in this implementation.
